response.description:
As
organizations adopt AI agents and MCP-based tooling, integration teams often
need to build and maintain custom API layers just to make existing
workflows callable by agents. This additional plumbing increases
development effort, operational complexity, and time to production.  With the
GA release of the Azure Logic Apps MCP Server, developers can now expose
existing Logic Apps workflows as MCP-compatible tools that AI agents can
directly discover and invoke — without writing custom API code. This
allows teams to:  
 Expose existing Logic Apps
     workflows as AI-callable MCP tools in minutes  
 Enable discovery and invocation
     from agent platforms such as Microsoft Foundry and Copilot Studio  
 Reuse existing enterprise
     automation and integration logic within AI workflows  
 Reduce the complexity and
     overhead of building custom integration layers for agents  By
enabling Logic Apps workflows to participate directly in MCP-based
agent ecosystems, the Logic Apps MCP Server helps organizations accelerate
agentic automation while maximizing reuse of existing enterprise
integrations.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure Logic Apps MCP Server.
